#en: By augmenting the pilot's understanding of electromagnetic properties, this Amp can boost a ship's EM damage.
zh: 通过增强飞行员对电磁特性的理解，这个增幅能提升飞船的电磁伤害。

#en: Understand, since you use this vessel to land on planets, you'll not be able to utilize the installed system.
zh: 你要明白，既然你用这艘船降落行星，就无法使用已安装的系统。

#en: You can build a terminal aboard your ship -- granting you remote access to the main system here, on Stardock.
zh: 你可以在船上建一个终端——让你远程访问星坞这儿的主系统。

#en: Specific alloys, tools, and so on... Gather these materials, and you can now build these components yourself.
zh: 特定的合金、工具等等……集齐这些材料，你现在就能自己制造这些部件了。

#en: But once built, it could be mobilized multiple times, providing you give enough time for the mech's recovery.
zh: 但一旦造好，它可以反复部署，只要你给机甲足够的恢复时间。

#en: I wonder... Got some pals that like to travel, always have eyes on certain systems. But they'll want credits.
zh: 让我想想……我有些爱旅行的朋友，总盯着某些星系。但他们要信用点。

#en: Ah, I guess my own little antics left an impression on ya. Probably... shouldn't be proud of that, but, I am!
zh: 啊，看来我自己那些小把戏给你留下印象了。大概……不该为此骄傲，但我确实骄傲！

#en: I could be wrong... but I think this universe's Gren has a slightly better sense of humor! But only slightly.
zh: 我可能说错……但我觉得这个宇宙的格伦幽默感稍好一点！只是一点点。

#en: Giving you time to recover, get back in the fight, and avoid capture! Think about it! It makes sense, right?!
zh: 给你时间恢复、重新投入战斗、避免被抓！想想看！这说得通吧？！

#en: I know the UC dangles citizenship as some sort of "rare prize", but it's not really that uncommon of a thing.
zh: 我知道联殖把公民身份当成某种「稀有奖励」来吊人，但其实没那么稀罕。

#en: Come meet me at Stardock as soon as you can, and we can start rebuilding our fleet! Okay, then. See you soon!
zh: 尽快到星坞来找我，我们就能开始重建舰队！那好。回头见！

#en: Well, we got a fleet! No reason not to head out right away! If you don't mind, I'll join you aboard your ship.
zh: 好，我们有舰队了！没理由不马上出发！你不介意的话，我就上你的船一起走。

#en: For that, we need to go talk with Gren! He's a ship engineer, can help us get everything set up and installed.
zh: 为此，我们得去跟格伦谈谈！他是飞船工程师，能帮我们把一切置办好装好。

#en: I'll transfer the credits for the ships you sent my way. I also recovered several Watchtower components. Here.
zh: 我把你送来的那几艘船的钱转给你。我还回收了几个瞭望塔部件。给你。

#en: ...Mech being a problem? Just shut it down with an override! I mean, if you've got the security card, why not?
zh: ……机甲碍事？用越权指令把它关掉不就行了！既然你有安保卡，干吗不用？

#en: This could take a while. Who knows where she is... I'll be back as soon as I've got news. Until then, rest up!
zh: 这可能要花些时间。谁知道她在哪儿……一有消息我就回来。在那之前，好好休息！

#en: She's not let us down yet! No reason for her to turn on us. As long as we pay her, she'll get us what we need.
zh: 她还没让我们失望过！没理由反水。只要给钱，她就会把我们要的东西弄来。

#en: I'll need to stay in orbit in order to use Skydrop. You'll need to land and find the exterior of the facility.
zh: 要使用空投，我得留在轨道上。你得降落，找到设施的外部。

#en: Time to get moving! Jump in your ship and meet me outside. Hail me when you're ready, and we'll plot a course!
zh: 该出发了！上你的船，到外面跟我碰头。准备好就呼叫我，我们设定航线！

#en: ...I really hope you got that. Because if I try to dumb it down anymore, I'm honestly afraid you might hit me.
zh: ……真希望你听懂了。因为要我再讲得更简单，我真怕你会揍我。

#en: *sigh* ...Just how many times are you gonna pass through The Unity, anyway...? Ah, never mind. You good to go?
zh: *叹气* ……你到底还要穿过多少遍归一……？啊，算了。你准备好了吗？

#en: Oh, we already know all about them! A real wealth of information. At least until they erase themselves that is.
zh: 哦，我们早就把它们摸清了！信息量真不小。至少在它们自我清除之前。

#en: I mean, some systems don't even have planets you could put a Listening Post on! So, would they have them there?
zh: 我是说，有些星系连能放监听哨的行星都没有！那他们会在那儿设吗？

#en: A bit of a brawl down below, then blew up an Array for intel! You might wanna use Gren's program on that Slate.
zh: 下面打了场小架，然后炸了个阵列换情报！你那块数据板也许该用格伦的程序跑跑。

#en: None of them were no match for us, of course! And then we recovered that Intel Slate from the Array's wreckage.
zh: 他们当然都不是我们的对手！然后我们从阵列残骸里回收了那块情报数据板。

#en: We actually already have experience searching for Watchtower facilities. I think we know just what to look for.
zh: 我们其实已经有搜寻瞭望塔设施的经验了。我们大概知道该找什么。

#en: On the way back from our supply run, one of his scans picks up some weird signal from the system we're passing.
zh: 补给回来路上，他的某次扫描在我们路过的星系捕捉到奇怪信号。

#en: So, here you are! This is the Cyberamp I already fabricated. Use it in good health! Or don't, It's your choice.
zh: 所以，拿着！这是我已造好的赛博增幅。祝你用得顺心！不想用也行，随你。

#en: Like any other ranking member of the organization, I was only ever given enough information to perform my role.
zh: 和组织里其他有身份的成员一样，我只被给予履行职责所需的信息。

#en: I'll see what I can do. You want a Listening Post in a more calm system, or somewhere that'll test your nerves?
zh: 我看看能怎么办。你想要平静星系里的监听哨，还是考验胆量的那种？

#en: ...Unless you reactivated it. I dunno why you would do that, but, if you really wanted to, I guess you could...
zh: ……除非你把它重新激活了。我不知道你为什么要那么做，但你要是真想，大概也能……

#en: Never mind the added challenge of piggybacking a jump! But it obviously worked. And I'm glad to see we made it!
zh: 更别提搭便车跳跃的额外难度了！但显然奏效了。很高兴我们都到了！

#en: They disable one ship, and then ANOTHER comes at them! Oh no, their Disruptor hasn't had a chance to recharge!!
zh: 他们瘫痪一艘船，然后又有一艘扑上来！糟了，他们的干扰器还没来得及充能！！

#en: Hmm... Maybe! I did see something about Listening Posts in other systems... Hold on, lemme run a quick search...
zh: 嗯……也许吧！我确实见过提到其他星系有监听哨……等等，我快速搜一下……

#en: We can't progress until you have another vessel. Come back as soon as you have one. Or, you can always use mine.
zh: 你没有另一艘船，我们就没法推进。有了就回来。或者，你随时可以用我的。

#en: Triggers a contained fusion event, unleashing destructive energy. Quite catastrophic to those within its radius.
zh: 触发一次受控聚变，释放毁灭性能量。对半径内的一切极具破坏性。

#en: Sure did! Now, I already knew Watchtower likes to dabble in cybernetic tech. One look at Gren gives that away...
zh: 当然！我早知道瞭望塔喜欢碰赛博格技术。看一眼格伦就露馅了……

#en: Uploading the coordinates. It's in your hands now. Just don't get too cocksure! You don't wanna be like Torin...
zh: 正在上传坐标。现在交给你了。别太自以为是！你可不想变成托林那样……

#en: Sorry! Completely my bad on forgetting about the mech. Sorry you ended up getting hit by the disruptor -- again.
zh: 抱歉！忘了机甲的事全是我的错。抱歉你又挨了干扰器——又一次。

#en: I'll catch up as soon as I can. So you just focus on the Control Node inside the facility. Let's make it happen!
zh: 我尽快赶过去。你专心找设施里的控制节点。把它办成！

#en: You'll have some time to relax while I work on this. Get comfortable! I'll be back as soon as there's an update.
zh: 我处理的时候你有时间放松一下。找个舒服的地方待着！一有进展我就回来。

#en: This may take a day or two. You should grab a bunk, get some rest. I'll let you know as soon as I have any news.
zh: 这可能要一两天。找个床铺休息一下吧。一有消息我就通知你。

#en: Okay! Now, we know what we need -- the Control Node, and we know where to get it -- the facility on Eridani III.
zh: 好！现在我们知道了需要什么——控制节点，也知道去哪儿拿——波江座III上的设施。

#en: --No! Nothing like that... At least, I don't think so. This facility we're going to break into, it's Watchtower.
zh: ——不！不是那种……至少我觉得不是。我们要闯的那座设施，是瞭望塔的。

#en: You may call me <Alias=Player>. It's no mistake our paths crossed. Let us travel the stars together, for a time.
zh: 你可以叫我<Alias=Player>。我们的路交汇并非偶然。让我们一同在星海间旅行一段时间。

#en: Sorry, you're... you're asking why you can't move?! Well, like I said, you were hit by a Neural Disruption Beam.
zh: 抱歉，你……你问为什么动不了？！嗯，我说过，你中了神经干扰束。

#en: Ah, yeah... Yeah, you won't be able to talk for a while. Or move, either. Heh. Your neurons are all scrambled...
zh: 啊，是啊……对，你有一阵子说不了话。也动不了。嘿。你的神经元全被打乱了……

#en: Gren said as much. He--... Damn, that thing wiped itself fast! But not fast enough. I managed to pull a location!
zh: 格伦也这么说。他——……该死，那东西清得真快！但还不够快。我成功挖出一个位置！

#en: Me? Uh... Not much to tell. I mean, I grew up in Neon. Lost more to that city than I care to share... So, I left!
zh: 我？呃……没什么好说的。我是霓虹城长大的。在那座城失去的比我想说的多……所以我走了！

#en: I can't say I fully understand this Cyberamp, but I'd assume, like most others, it provides some sort of benefit.
zh: 我不能说完全懂这个赛博增幅，但我猜和其他大多数一样，能提供某种好处。

#en: With some sentient AI adapters and enough data from cores, I believe I could construct something wholly original.
zh: 有感知人工智能适配器，加上核心里足够的数据，我相信我能造出全新的东西。

#en: Mobilizes a medical support unit. Capable of stabilizing injuries and administering basic treatment in the field.
zh: 部署一支医疗支援单位。能够稳定伤情并在战场进行基础治疗。

#en: But the outlook of most Watchtower operatives is... hmm, "fanatical" would not be the right word, but it's close.
zh: 但大多数瞭望塔特工的观念……嗯，「狂热」不算贴切，但也接近了。

#en: Things were okay for a while. But as corporations expanded, independent engineers like me -- started losing work.
zh: 有一阵还行。但随着企业扩张，像我这样的独立工程师——开始没活干。

#en: Okay. Just don't underestimate Watchtower. In this universe, they're still a threat. I'll be waiting here for ya.
zh: 好。别低估瞭望塔。在这个宇宙，他们仍是威胁。我在这儿等你。

#en: ...Huh. That's a... That's a fair question. I'm trying to think of how to answer without worrying you too much...
zh: ……哦。这……这问题问得有理。我在想怎么回答才能不让你太担心……

#en: They sure are! I've had more than a few run-ins with good old Watchtower. Most encounters have.... not gone well.
zh: 确实有！我跟熟悉的瞭望塔碰过不止一次。大多数遭遇都……不太顺利。

#en: Did you forget the whole "signal me" plan? You know, let me know where you are so we can stop you being captured?
zh: 你忘了那个「给我发信号」的计划？就是告诉我你在哪儿，好防止你被抓？

#en: On detonation, releases a corrosive gas harmful to both organic and synthetic entities. Effective for area denial.
zh: 引爆时释放腐蚀性气体，对有机体和人造体都有害。适合封锁区域。

#en: But, who knows! Maybe at some point, we'll find the keys to unlockin' some of that! Wouldn't that be something...?
zh: 但谁知道呢！也许哪天我们会找到解开其中一部分的钥匙！那岂不是……？

#en: If you don't mind paying criminal types, I know one or two people who could get what we need! For the right price.
zh: 你要是不介意花钱雇罪犯，我认识一两个能弄到我们需要的东西的人！价钱到位就行。

#en: Yeah... No can do. You've been flagged. Which means they'll find you no matter where you go. But there is a way...
zh: 是啊……做不到。你已被标记。这意味着你走到哪儿他们都能找到你。但有个办法……

#en: Hah! Yeah, uh, can't say I'm surprised they turned on you. Although, I'm a little shocked it didn't happen sooner.
zh: 哈！是啊，呃，他们对你翻脸我一点都不意外。不过，我有点惊讶居然没更早发生。

#en: Watchtower is a highly-secretive organization, even to those within it. All information is on a need-to-know basis.
zh: 瞭望塔是个高度保密的组织，对内部人也是如此。所有信息都按需知原则处理。

#en: I grew up in Akila City, big skies, tight communities, and more than enough trouble to keep a young woman occupied.
zh: 我在阿基拉城长大，天空辽阔，社群紧密，麻烦多到足够填满一个年轻女人的生活。

#en: The neural restructuring serves to "alleviate" these areas, freeing them to serve host to the needs of the implant.
zh: 神经重构的作用是「缓解」这些区域，腾出来承载植入体的需求。

#en: The Watchtower vessel was destroyed, and the pirates now attacked Torin's ship. But we managed to safely jump away.
zh: 瞭望塔的飞船被摧毁，海盗转而攻击托林的船。但我们成功安全跃迁脱离。

#en: ...Hah. Kidding! Kidding. Maybe I help just 'cause I like you. Sometimes, these sorta things are as simple as that.
zh: ……哈。开玩笑！开玩笑。也许我帮你只是因为喜欢你。有时候这种事就这么简单。

#en: I'll get the corvette prepped to fire the Disruptor. Be a pal? Go flip those power switches! Okay. Let's get to it!
zh: 我去准备护卫舰发射干扰器。帮个忙？去把那些电源开关扳上！好。我们开始！

#en: *sigh* We've jumped so many times, I-- we've run out of letters! So from now on, I'm just gonna stick with "Omega".
zh: *叹气* 我们跳跃太多次了，我——字母都不够用了！所以从今往后，我就只用「奥米伽」了。

#en: So I'm gonna have to bum a ride. Don't worry though, I am a great co-pilot! I only ever crash ships when I mean to.
zh: 所以我得蹭个车了。不过别担心，我是很棒的副驾驶！我只在故意的时候才撞船。

#en: Okay, good! I'm happy you're on board with this fleet idea! Hah! You know, that... that the first time that we--...
zh: 好，太好了！很高兴你接受这个舰队方案！哈！你知道，那是……那是我们第一次——……

#en: ...Yeah! You know about this kinda stuff? When I searched for specific data, it just... started deleting everything!
zh: ……对！你懂这类事？我一搜特定数据，它就……开始把一切都删了！

#en: Not sure exactly. Information is hazy... Almost seems on purpose! Like they preemptively scrubbed any major details.
zh: 不太确定。信息很模糊……几乎像是故意的！像是他们预先抹掉了所有关键细节。

#en: But first, you'll need to assign a ship to your fleet. Watchtower's out there, remember? We need to cover our asses.
zh: 但首先，你得给舰队分配一艘船。瞭望塔还在外面，记得吗？我们得自保。

#en: Suffice it to say, the Fleet Command System exploits Watchtower technology to our benefit. It's robust and adaptive.
zh: 总之，舰队指挥系统利用瞭望塔的技术为我们服务。它坚固且自适应。

#en: Got it right here! Was exactly where you said we'd find it. Although, a heads-up about the mechs would've been nice.
zh: 就在这儿！跟你说的位置一模一样。不过，早点提醒有机甲就好了。

#en: It's not without its flaws, though. Akila can be rough around the edges. Much like the rest of the Freestar systems.
zh: 不过它也并非没有缺点。阿基拉有些粗粝。自由星系联盟其他星系也差不多。

#en: I've stripped those ships. Transferring credits. Additionally, I extracted several unique components. All yours now.
zh: 那几艘船我拆了。正在转账。另外，我还提取了几个独特部件。现在都归你。

#en: I scrapped that vessel. Here are your credits. And I pulled something extra too, Watchtower tech. Here, you take it.
zh: 那艘船我拆了。这是你的钱。我还额外弄到些东西，瞭望塔的技术。给，你拿着。

#en: Deploys a single high-impact missile from orbit. Precise and devastating, suitable for eliminating hardened targets.
zh: 从轨道部署一枚高冲击导弹。精准且具毁灭性，适合摧毁坚固目标。

#en: Systems failing, hull breaches everywhere. Things seemed bleak. Torin then asked me to free him from his restraints.
zh: 系统失灵，船体到处破口。形势一片黯淡。托林这时让我解开他的束缚。

#en: Think... faster weapon locking, sharper maneuvering. Basically anything to turn a regular pilot into a seasoned pro.
zh: 想想看……更快的武器锁定、更敏捷的机动。总之就是把普通飞行员变成老手。

#en: We cannot fight this thing! It-- Its shields, there's no way we can get through those! The firepower needed... to...
zh: 我们打不过这玩意儿！它——它的护盾，我们根本穿不过去！需要的火力……得……

#en: ...I've launched the Comm Beacon. By the time we arrive at Heimdall Station, they should be prepped for containment.
zh: ……我已发射通讯信标。等我们抵达海姆达尔站，他们应该已做好收容准备。

#en: No, the technology is similar, but fundamentally different... It's more invasive, closer to true cybernetics, really.
zh: 不，技术相似，但根本不同……它更具侵入性，其实更接近真正的赛博格化。

#en: I was part of a Watchtower crew -- dispatched to capture Torin. We disabled him and his ship, and brought him aboard.
zh: 我曾是瞭望塔一支船组的成员——被派去抓捕托林。我们瘫痪了他和他的船，把他带上船。

#en: This is almost getting ridiculous... So much attention for such a tiny station! *sigh* At least it's keeping me busy.
zh: 这几乎有点荒唐了……这么小的空间站引来这么多关注！*叹气* 至少让我有事可做。

#en: If we passed along the means on how to search and scan for Watchtower outposts, they may be able to find them for us.
zh: 如果把我们搜寻扫描瞭望塔前哨的方法给他们，他们或许能替我们找到。

#en: Mostly setting everything up again! I had to go find my ship, rescue Gren, then help Harper get Stardock operational.
zh: 主要是在重新安顿一切！我得去找回我的船、救出格伦，然后帮哈珀让星坞运转起来。

#en: ...I'm glad we're doing this, you and me. We'll show Watchtower they picked the wrong people to mess with. This time.
zh: ……很高兴我们一起干这事。我们要让瞭望塔知道他们惹错了人。这次。

#en: But the problem is, Control Node's not easily accessible. It's stored away in an old facility, with no simple way in.
zh: 但问题是，控制节点不好拿。它存在一座旧设施里，没有简单的进入方式。

#en: I assume you recall their method of capture...? Yeah, kinda hard to forget it once you've experienced it firsthand...
zh: 我想你记得他们的抓捕手段……？是啊，亲身体验过一次就很难忘……

#en: Initial flag could've been a false positive. It does happen! However, could also be a case of latent manifestation...
zh: 最初的标记可能是误报。这确实会发！不过，也可能是潜在显现的情况……

#en: I mean, maybe it's different for you, but I always find going through The Unity is disorienting at the best of times.
zh: 我是说，也许你不一样，但我一向觉得穿过归一即使在最好的情况下也令人晕头转向。

#en: Sorry to leave you hanging like I did, but I had no way to contact you! I just... made my way back as fast as I could!
zh: 抱歉那样把你晾着，但我没法联系你！我只能……尽快赶回来！

#en: Medicine was always my goal, so I trained as a doctor. But life took a turn when Aetherium Cybernetics came calling...
zh: 从医一直是我的目标，所以我接受了医生训练。但以太赛博公司找上门后，人生就转了向……

#en: This Amp reduces acceleration inhibition. With it installed, a pilot will feel compelled to achieve higher top speeds.
zh: 这个增幅能降低加速抑制。装上后，飞行员会不由自主地追求更高极速。

#en: Delivers a cache of essential supplies, including ammunition and equipment. Designed to sustain prolonged engagements.
zh: 投送一批必需补给，包括弹药和装备。专为维持持久交火设计。

#en: Watchtower is... difficult to explain. Everything, and I mean everything, is compartmentalized, strictly need-to-know.
zh: 瞭望塔……很难解释。一切，我是说一切，都被分割隔离，严格按需知原则。

#en: I was curious, so I went to take a look. It was just a wreck! Abandoned, forgotten. Hah, kinda reminded me of someone.
zh: 我好奇，就去看了看。只是一具残骸！被遗弃，被遗忘。哈，有点像某个人。

#en: But now? I dunno. You're... different. You've got that same spark Torin does. Just feels right that I lend you a hand.
zh: 但现在？我不知道。你……不一样。你有托林那种劲头。帮你一把感觉就该这样。

#en: That Computer Core you gave me? I asked an old friend to help me poke around inside it, see what data we could find...
zh: 你给我的那块计算机核心？我请了个老朋友帮我翻查里面，看能找到什么数据……

#en: Thought you should know, I sat down and did a tally... Listed out all the systems you've cleared of Listening Posts...
zh: 想让你知道，我坐下来数了数……列出你清掉监听哨的所有星系……

#en: Good morning, sunshine! The Advocate came through for us! She's already recovered the Control Node, got it right here!
zh: 早上好，阳光！辩护者帮我们办成了！她已经取回控制节点，就在这儿！

#en: You're at the start of a great journey... Watchtower would take that away from you. That's why you need to avoid them.
zh: 你正处在一次伟大旅程的开端……瞭望塔会把它夺走。所以你得避开他们。

#en: That's right, we're blasting this sucker open! And I've only got one missile on board, so make sure you don't mess up.
zh: 没错，我们要把这玩意儿炸开！我船上只有一枚导弹，所以你千万别搞砸。

#en: The Control Node integrated without issue. You now have a mainframe fully-capable of fleet management and coordination.
zh: 控制节点已顺利整合。你现在有了一台完全能管理协调舰队的主机。

#en: They lured me in with promises of credits and groundbreaking research, and for a while, I thought I'd found my purpose.
zh: 他们用信用点和突破性研究把我引进去，有段时间我以为自己找到了使命。

#en: I dismantled that ship. Here are the credits. I also extracted several Watchtower parts, maybe you'll find them useful.
zh: 那艘船我拆了。这是你的钱。我还提取了几个瞭望塔零件，也许你用得上。

#en: One more thing. I've documented how to build a remote Fleet Command System terminal. I'll forward you the schematics...
zh: 还有一件事。我把如何建造远程舰队指挥系统终端记录下来了。图纸我会发给你……

#en: They offered me better pay for "special projects". I needed the credits, so I accepted. That's how I joined Watchtower.
zh: 他们为「特殊项目」给我更高的报酬。我需要钱，就答应了。我就这样加入了瞭望塔。

#en: Before we could grav jump out, a Crimson Fleet squadron caught us by surprise. They hit hard. Our ship was overwhelmed.
zh: 我们还没能重力跃迁出去，一支深红舰队中队就突袭了我们。他们打得很凶。我们的船被压制了。

#en: They will be costly to construct and require you to source the necessary mech components, there's no way around that...
zh: 它们的建造费用不低，还需要你搞到必要的机甲部件，这点绕不开……

#en: Station used to be a Freestar Collective outpost, back during the Colony War. But it was abandoned after the Armistice.
zh: 这座空间站曾是自由星系联盟的前哨站，在殖民地大战期间。但停战后就被废弃了。

#en: You know, hacking, cybersecurity, digital warfare. All that good stuff! We kept in contact after I left Neon. Good guy!
zh: 你知道，黑客、网络安全、数字战。全是好本事！我离开霓虹城后我们一直有联系。好人！

#en: Check it out, new tables! Had to expand the seating arrangements. Can't have people standing around like it's a dive...
zh: 看看，新桌子！得扩充座位。总不能让人像在破酒吧里似的站着……

#en: Or, if you'd prefer, we could try hiring the Advocate? She could take care of this for us. Would cost us Astra, though.
zh: 或者，如果你愿意，我们可以试着雇辩护者？她能替我们办妥。不过要花阿斯特拉。

#en: Heh. And it's likely during those travels I got the attention of Watchtower. Been trying to shake 'em off ever since...
zh: 嘿。大概就是在那段旅行中我引起了瞭望塔的注意。从那以后我一直想甩掉他们……

#en: Uh... House Va'ruun, huh? That could explain Watchtower's interest in you. But still, I-- I dunno. Doesn't seem to fit.
zh: 呃……瓦鲁家族，嗯？那也许能解释瞭望塔为什么对你感兴趣。不过，我——我不知道。好像不太对得上。

#en: But you do seem to know our code structure. Ready yourself for processing! We're gonna have a lot of questions for you.
zh: 但你似乎知道我们的码结构。准备接受处理！我们会有很多问题问你。

#en: Look. I'm still here, you're still here. That's what's important. The specifics, those will come when the time is right.
zh: 听着。我还在这儿，你也还在这儿。这才是重要的。细节等时机到了再说。

#en: From what I gleaned, Watchtower's corporate ties were just as, if not more, important as their government infiltrations.
zh: 据我所知，瞭望塔与企业的关系，其重要性不亚于甚至超过他们对政府的渗透。

#en: I think I make her uncomfortable. Others have reacted to me this way too. So, I mostly keep to myself -- in my workshop.
zh: 我想我让她不自在。别人也对我有这种反应。所以我大多独处——待在工坊里。

#en: A number of upgrades to improve your combat mech, along with new polarized armor plating to deflect contraband scanning.
zh: 若干升级以改进你的战斗机甲，还有新的极化装甲板，可偏转违禁品扫描。

#en: Intriguing... These mech components you've obtained, providing I can recover the relevant data from a number of cores...
zh: 有意思……你弄到的这些机甲部件，只要我能从若干核心里恢复相关数据……

#en: I'm no expert, but from what we pulled, looks like Watchtower's got amps that can boost someone's ship-flying abilities.
zh: 我不是专家，但据我们提取的，瞭望塔有能增强飞船驾驶能力的增幅。

#en: Time to get rolling. Gren and Harper are waiting, so let's go make introductions. Don't forget, this is all new to them!
zh: 该出发了。格伦和哈珀等着呢，我们去互相介绍。别忘了，这些对他们都是新的！

#en: That is our solution! You ever hear about the orbital drops -- the UC and Freestar Collective did during the Colony War?
zh: 那就是我们的办法！你听说过殖民地大战时联殖和自由星系联盟做的轨道空投吗？

#en: ...Hehehe. But once we stopped tryin' to kill each other, we figured out we both just wanted a safe place to set up shop.
zh: ……呵呵。但我们一停止互相残杀，就发现我们其实都只想要个安全的地方落脚。

#en: Torin's friend, huh? You don't strike me as a Watchtower fan. If you're itchin' to fight back,  drop by and see me later.
zh: 托林的朋友，是吧？你不像是瞭望塔的拥趸。你要是想反击，晚点过来找我。
